description: This PHP class defines a data model for handling claim request information within the OrangeHRM system's API. It utilizes annotations for OpenAPI documentation and implements a normalizable interface for serialization. The class maps claim request entity attributes to API response structure.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestModel
classes.description: A model class representing claim request data for API responses, implementing normalization and using OpenAPI annotations to define schema.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ClaimRequest entity and sets up property filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
